answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Reaching the knoll of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, forfeited on duplicate submission, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Work waits on the nadir until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the nectar of the next round.
